cohort: Preterm infants (26 to <37 weeks gestation) discharged from Kiwoko Hospital neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) from July 2017 to June 2018, admitted within 24 hours of birth, with at least 7 days hospital stay, and excluding major congenital anomalies and missing gestational age or birth weight.
finding: Postnatal growth failure occurred in 73% of preterm infants, and was significantly associated with delayed initiation of enteral feeds, sepsis, multiple gestation, and male gender.
